explanation: Mathlib has `AlgebraicGeometry.nilradical_eq_bot`, which proves only `IsReduced Y → Y.nilradical = ⊥`, and the ring-level `nilradical_eq_bot_iff`. I found no Mathlib declaration of the scheme-level equivalence. The reverse implication requires passing from the vanishing nilradical to reducedness on affine opens and then using an open cover, so it is not a one- or two-line derivation from the ring-level result.
